𝗛𝗮𝗿𝗼𝗼𝗻 𝗞𝗵𝗮𝗻, 𝗗𝗲𝗽𝘂𝘁𝘆 𝗗𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗼𝗿 𝗕𝗕𝗜𝗦𝗘, accompanied by 𝗠𝗿. 𝗠𝘂𝗵𝗮𝗺𝗺𝗮𝗱 𝗥𝗮𝗺𝘇𝗮𝗻 and 𝗠𝗿. 𝗔𝗾𝗶𝗯 𝗞𝗵𝗮𝗻, visited 𝗠𝘂𝗿𝗮𝗱 & 𝗭𝗮𝗿𝗮 𝗙𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗦𝗰𝗵𝗼𝗼𝗹, 𝗞𝘂𝗰𝗵𝗹𝗮𝗾, a welfare-based primary school where the Foundation bears the educational expenses of the students. The team interacted with the administration, teachers, and students and appreciated the school’s 𝗻𝗲𝗮𝘁 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝘄𝗲𝗹𝗹-𝗼𝗿𝗴𝗮𝗻𝗶𝘇𝗲𝗱 𝗲𝗻𝘃𝗶𝗿𝗼𝗻𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁, 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗹𝘆 𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗱 𝗰𝗹𝗮𝘀𝘀𝗿𝗼𝗼𝗺𝘀, 𝘃𝗶𝗴𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗮𝗱𝗺𝗶𝗻𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻, 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗳𝗶𝗲𝗱 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗺𝗶𝘁𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝘁𝗲𝗮𝗰𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗳𝗳. The students also demonstrated encouraging enthusiasm for 𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗱𝘀-𝗼𝗻 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗮𝗰𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗶𝘁𝘆-𝗯𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴. Prof. Haroon Khan emphasized 𝘀𝗸𝗶𝗹𝗹-𝗯𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻, particularly 𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴, 𝘄𝗿𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴, 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗿𝗲𝗵𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻, and encouraged teachers to develop students’ 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗯𝗹𝗲𝗺-𝘀𝗼𝗹𝘃𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀 rather than relying on rote memorization. The visit appreciated the Foundation’s valuable contribution to providing 𝗮𝗰𝗰𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 and strengthened the shared commitment to improving learning at the grassroots level. #BBISE #AcademicOutreach #MuradAndZaraFoundation #Kuchlaq #QualityEducation #SkillBasedEducation #HandsOnLearning #ActivityBasedLearning #EducationForAll #BalochistanEducation #Learning #MediaAndResearch

📚 𝗕𝗕𝗜𝗦𝗘 𝗔𝗰𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗺𝗶𝗰 𝗢𝘂𝘁𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗰𝗵 & 𝗔𝘄𝗮𝗿𝗲𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗩𝗶𝘀𝗶𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗚𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗚𝗶𝗿𝗹𝘀 𝗛�... 📚 𝗕𝗕𝗜𝗦𝗘 𝗔𝗰𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗺𝗶𝗰 𝗢𝘂𝘁𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗰𝗵 & 𝗔𝘄𝗮𝗿𝗲𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗩𝗶𝘀𝗶𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗚𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗚𝗶𝗿𝗹𝘀 𝗛𝗶𝗴𝗵 𝗦𝗰𝗵𝗼𝗼𝗹, 𝗞𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗶 𝗨𝗺𝗮𝗿, 𝗤𝘂𝗲𝘁𝘁𝗮 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝗻𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗦𝗰𝗵𝗼𝗼𝗹𝘀 • 𝗖𝗹𝗮𝗿𝗶𝗳𝘆𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗥𝗲𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝘀 • 𝗦𝘁𝗿𝗲𝗻𝗴𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 As part of its academic outreach initiative, 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗳. 𝗛𝗮𝗿𝗼𝗼𝗻 𝗞𝗵𝗮𝗻, 𝗗𝗲𝗽𝘂𝘁𝘆 𝗗𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗼𝗿 𝗕𝗕𝗜𝗦𝗘, accompanied by 𝗠𝗿. 𝗔𝗾𝗶𝗯 𝗞𝗵𝗮𝗻, visited 𝗚𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗚𝗶𝗿𝗹𝘀 𝗛𝗶𝗴𝗵 𝗦𝗰𝗵𝗼𝗼𝗹, 𝗞𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗶 𝗨𝗺𝗮𝗿, 𝗤𝘂𝗲𝘁𝘁𝗮, and interacted with the Principal and teaching staff. 🎯 The session covered the 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗶𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝗰𝘂𝗿𝗿𝗶𝗰𝘂𝗹𝘂𝗺 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝘀𝘆𝗹𝗹𝗮𝗯𝘂𝘀, 𝗺𝗼𝗱𝗲𝗹 𝗽𝗮𝗽𝗲𝗿𝘀, 𝘂𝗽𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝗲𝘅𝗮𝗺𝗶𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗽𝗮𝗽𝗲𝗿 𝗽𝗮𝘁𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗻𝘀, 𝗣𝗿𝗮𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹-𝗕𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝗔𝘀𝘀𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 (𝗣𝗕𝗔), 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗷𝗲𝗰𝘁-𝗕𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝗔𝘀𝘀𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁, followed by an interactive Q&A to address teachers’ concerns and clarify the reforms. 🔬 A particularly encouraging feature of the visit was the inspection of the school’s 𝗹𝗮𝗯𝗼𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘆 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝘀𝘁𝘂𝗱𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀’ 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗷𝗲𝗰𝘁 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸. The students had prepared 𝗱𝗼𝘇𝗲𝗻𝘀 𝗼𝗳 𝗺𝗼𝗱𝗲𝗹𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗷𝗲𝗰𝘁𝘀, demonstrating remarkable enthusiasm for 𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗱𝘀-𝗼𝗻, 𝗮𝗰𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗶𝘁𝘆-𝗯𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴. Prof. Haroon Khan expressed his satisfaction with their work and appreciated the efforts of the students, teachers, and school administration. 💡 The delegation highlighted that 𝗽𝗿𝗮𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗷𝗲𝗰𝘁-𝗯𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 takes education 𝗯𝗲𝘆𝗼𝗻𝗱 𝘁𝗲𝘅𝘁𝗯𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀, fostering 𝗽𝘀𝘆𝗰𝗵𝗼𝗺𝗼𝘁𝗼𝗿 𝘀𝗸𝗶𝗹𝗹𝘀, 𝗰𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗶𝘁𝘆, 𝗰𝗿𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴, 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗯𝗹𝗲𝗺-𝘀𝗼𝗹𝘃𝗶𝗻𝗴, 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗳 𝗸𝗻𝗼𝘄𝗹𝗲𝗱𝗴𝗲. 🤝 The visit further strengthened 𝗕𝗕𝗜𝗦𝗘–𝘀𝗰𝗵𝗼𝗼𝗹 𝗰𝗼𝗹𝗹𝗮𝗯𝗼𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 and the shared commitment to translating assessment reforms into improved 𝘁𝗲𝗮𝗰𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗴, 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴, 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗮𝘀𝘀𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗽𝗿𝗮𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗲𝘀 across Balochistan. 🇵🇰 **Celebrating Pakistan’s 79th Independence Day at BISE Peshawar** 🇵🇰 The **Board of Intermediate and Secondary Ed... 🇵🇰 **Celebrating Pakistan’s 79th Independence Day at BISE Peshawar** 🇵🇰 The **Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education (BISE) Peshawar** proudly celebrated the **79th Independence Day of Pakistan** with great national spirit, enthusiasm, and a renewed commitment to serving our beloved country. 💚🤍 The ceremony commenced with the **hoisting of the National Flag by Mr. Khuda Bakhsh, Chairman BISE Peshawar**, in the presence of officers and officials of the Board. As the green and white flag rose proudly, the occasion reflected our shared love for Pakistan and our respect for the sacrifices made for its independence. 🇵🇰 🌱 **Planting for a Greener Pakistan** To commemorate this historic day with a message for the future, the Chairman also **planted a tree on the premises of BISE Peshawar**. The plantation symbolized **hope, growth, sustainability, and our collective responsibility to leave a greener and more prosperous Pakistan for future generations.** As we celebrate **79 years of independence**, BISE Peshawar reaffirms its commitment to **education, integrity, public service, and the progress of Pakistan**. May our beloved homeland continue to prosper and shine for generations to come. **Pakistan Zindabad! 🇵🇰💚** #PakistanIndependenceDay #14August #79thIndependenceDay #PakistanZindabad #BISEPeshawar #IndependenceDay2026 #Peshawar #KhyberPakhtunkhwa #GreenPakistan #PlantForPakistan #ProudPakistani

Distinguished Guests Attend Certificates Distribution Ceremony at Richmond Institute Australia Faisalabad Professor Dr. Rana Binyamin, Chairman, Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education Faisalabad, attended the Certificates Distribution Ceremony at Richmond Institute Australia, Faisalabad as a special guest. The ceremony was also attended by Dr. Ejaz Ahmad Tatla, Chairman BISE Multan; Rana Habib-ur-Rehman, Bureau Chief, Express News; Asif Sahib, CEO, Richmond ; and Rana Safdar Sahib, CEO, SB Store, along with other distinguished guests. The guests appreciated the institute’s efforts in promoting technical and vocational education and equipping youth with modern skills in freelancing, content development, web development, and other professional fields. Certificates were distributed among successful students and freelancers who completed various training programs.
